data.standardized_narrative: The report does not present a clear, explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure. The gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2013 (opening reserves at 1 January 2014) is identified as GBP 101.973m. No definitive gross prior-year strengthening or release amount is stated in the available notes; therefore a prior-year development amount could not be reliably extracted from the document images provided.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction from scanned/rotated images with limited resolution. Opening gross claims outstanding inferred from the Technical Provisions / Claims table (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2013 = GBP 101,973k). No unambiguous gross prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) or a clear gross 'movement in prior years' note was located in the provided images; P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines were present but are NOT an acceptable source for prior-year reserve movement per instructions and were therefore ignored. Segmental premium breakdown lines were not clearly legible enough to copy exact regulatory class names; gross premium total (42,243k) taken from the summary table but with moderate uncertainty. Where figures could not be confidently read they are left null and documented here.
